newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end stronger with help from futures.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end stronger with help from futures.

text.p: Tokyo stocks regained their feet by the end of Friday's session with help from trade linked to the futures market in the afternoon, brokers said.
They said, however, that a wait-and-see mood hung heavily over the market ahead of Japan's long weekend.
The cash market's key Nikkei 225 average ended 166.20 points, or 0.81 percent, higher at 20,633,06. In the futures market, the benchmark December futures contract finished 180 points up at 20,640.
"Futures buying emerged late in the afternoon, stimulating cash stocks and bringing up the Nikkei average," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
